summary: New entry based only on the two supplied Lahdo passages. Read-only input lookups found no ḥyḏ, ḥyd or yḥd entry. No etymology is supplied from outside the permitted evidence.
mḥayḏe after howina is a united-state predicate with ʕam ḥḏoḏe. miḥayḏina is reciprocal group action under lazəm. Neither attests an external uniter or a transitive active sense.
II and root spelling ḥyḏ follow the paired surface forms provisionally; active Preterit/Infectum are explicitly unattested, while miḥayḏ- is a segmented base from the actual 1pl form.
No new Idiomatic phrases: ʕam ḥḏoḏe supplies an ordinary reciprocal complement, not a separate lexicalized expression.

Confirm Part. Pass. classification of mḥayḏe, as opposed to a lexical adjective; its link to miḥayḏina supports the proposal here.
